root_cause.text: In sd_probe(), when device_add(&sdkp->disk_dev) fails, the error path calls put_device() which triggers scsi_disk_release() to free the scsi_disk but does not release the reference on the associated gendisk, causing a gendisk reference leak.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states: "If device_add(&sdkp->disk_dev) fails, put_device() runs scsi_disk_release(), which frees the scsi_disk but leaves the gendisk referenced. The device_add_disk() error path in sd_probe() calls put_disk(gd); call put_disk(gd) here to mirror that cleanup." The patch diff adds `put_disk(gd);` in the error path after `put_device(&sdkp->disk_dev);`.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add missing put_disk call in error path of sd_probe to fix a reference leak when device_add fails.
intent_record.what: Added a call to put_disk(gd) in the error path of sd_probe after a failed device_add, right before jumping to out label.
intent_record.how: This change ensures that the gendisk reference count is decremented when device_add fails, preventing a reference leak and allowing proper cleanup of the disk object.
